art.bubble: 払うのは降りるときだよ！
art.bubble_en: You pay when you get off!
art.title: POV: your first bus in Japan

gags: freeze snap inside a moving clip (driver and passengers freeze staring at the hand paying at boarding, bus swaying and city passing outside)
WRONG WAY / RIGHT WAY verdict stamps (overlays on moving footage)
silence-to-shout (male driver, male voice: 払うのは降りるときだよ！ / You pay when you get off!)
the wait (bus rolls and passengers sway while the POV fist waits with its ticket)
punchline: pay when you leave, not when you arrive.
pdca.hook: You board the bus and pay. Everyone stares.
pdca.note: 2026-11-27 night slot: bus_pay (transit) — the only unused producible topic (pour_beer and onsen retired as unproducible). Previous post ep35 is food, so the category changes. Hook adapts hook_library #24 mechanics (wrong action + its immediate public consequence in the first seconds — the fare-gate version). All 6 clips are real i2v (freeze/chapter/accept/shout/waiting/payoff; verdict reuses freeze.mp4 as in ep29-ep35). JP shout line carries its EN translation directly underneath in the bubble, and the male driver is voiced by ja-JP-KeitaNeural (male voice for a male character, per the 2026-11-24 gender rule). No real store names or trademarks used.
pdca.rule: On many city buses you pay when you get OFF — flat fare at the front.
